source: Moroney, Lee, O'Brien, Suijver, Marra (2016), Coffee extraction kinetics in a well mixed system, J. Math. Industry 7:3, Figure 5 panels (a) and (d), page 17.
experiment: 60 g of coffee grind mixed with 0.5 L of hot water, well mixed; average concentration of extracted solubles measured over time (paper section 3, page 7). Data originally from Moroney et al. 2015, ref. [5] of the paper.
extraction_method: Figure is vector graphics. Marker centres read from the PDF drawing commands (PyMuPDF get_drawings, fill colour 0.3/0.3/0.6). Axes calibrated by linear fits to the major tick marks (max tick residual 0.02 in t, 0.0002 in c_h). Axis meaning verified by re-solving the paper's equations (25)-(28) with its parameters and matching its printed curves to within 0.04.
time_unit: t is dimensionless on the surface-dissolution (inner) time scale: physical time = t * t_s, with t_s = 1.184 s (fine) and 19.389 s (coarse), page 10.
concentration_unit: c_h is dimensionless (inner concentration scale); only its shape is used, with a fitted amplitude.
